description: This file contains utility classes and functions related to fake tensor symbolic shape handling in PyTorch, including deconstruction and reconstruction of SymNode and SymType objects, and cache key management.

classes.name: _DeconstructedSymNode
classes.description: Represents a SymNode without the associated ShapeEnv, used for deconstruction and reconstruction.

classes.name: _DeconstructedSymType
classes.description: Represents a SymInt, SymFloat, or SymBool without the associated ShapeEnv.

classes.name: _InputBackref
classes.description: Back-reference to a previous input stub in cache key management.

classes.name: _PySymInputStub
classes.description: Wraps a SymInt or related symbolic type for cache key purposes, handling shape environment stripping.

classes.name: _SymIntOutputStub
classes.description: Represents a SymInt in the cache output, either as an index or deconstructed node.

classes.name: _CacheKeyState
classes.description: Maintains state during cache key construction, including symbol and SymNode tracking.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Reconstructs a SymNode or SymType from deconstructed components using a ShapeEnv.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts a PySymType from a _DeconstructedSymType using a ShapeEnv.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes cache key stub classes and state objects.

methods.name: strip_shape_env
methods.description: Removes shape environment information from a SymInt or related type.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts a SymInt or SymType from a stub, given a cache key and ShapeEnv.

methods.name: cache_on_shape_env
methods.description: Determines if cache key should be stored on ShapeEnv based on SymNode presence.

methods.name: convert_sym_int
methods.description: Converts a SymInt to a cache key stub, updating internal lookup and symbols.

methods.name: convert_output
methods.description: Converts a SymInt or related type to its cache output stub form.
